# DevCell

> Local-first sandbox for AI coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex,
> OpenCode, or Gemini inside an isolated container or VM with network
> egress locked down by default. Agents write, delete, and install
> freely. Your host is untouched. No account required.

DevCell is an open-source CLI tool (Apache 2.0) that wraps AI coding
agents in a sandboxed cell: a Docker container, macOS VM (Tart), or
Windows VM (winkit). It preserves your CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills, and
MCP config. Claude Max/Pro works without an API key.

Install: `brew install devcell-sh/tap/devcell`
Source: https://github.com/devcell-sh/devcell

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://devcell.sh/docs/quickstart): Install and run your first agent in under 5 minutes
- [Configuration](https://devcell.sh/docs/configuration): All TOML keys, env vars, and project config
- [Stacks and modules](https://devcell.sh/docs/stacks-and-modules): Image variants and toggleable Nix capabilities

## CLI reference

- [devcell claude](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_claude): Run Claude Code in a cell
- [devcell codex](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_codex): Run Codex in a cell
- [devcell gemini](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_gemini): Run Gemini CLI in a cell
- [devcell opencode](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_opencode): Run OpenCode in a cell
- [devcell shell](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_shell): Interactive shell or one-off command inside a cell
- [devcell build](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_build): Build or rebuild the image for a stack
- [devcell init](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_init): Scaffold devcell.toml in the current project
- [devcell modules list](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_modules_list): List available modules with sizes and MCP servers
- [devcell auth chrome](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_auth_chrome): Browser session handoff for in-cell Playwright
- [devcell models](https://devcell.sh/docs/devcell_models): Detect local and cloud LLMs

## Guides

- [Browser testing](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-browser-testing): Headed Chromium inside a container
- [Electronics / PCB](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-electronics): KiCad, ngspice, ESPHome workflows
- [MCP development](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-mcp-development): Build and test MCP servers
- [Multi-agent](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-multi-agent): Run multiple agents in the same workspace
- [Secrets](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-secrets): 1Password integration and credential handling
- [CI integration](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-ci): GitHub Actions and CI pipelines
- [macOS VM](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-macos-vm): Run agents inside a macOS VM via Tart
- [Desktop / GUI](https://devcell.sh/docs/howto-desktop): VNC and RDP access to the cell

## MCP servers

- [MCP overview](https://devcell.sh/docs/mcp-overview): How MCP servers are auto-configured
- [Playwright](https://devcell.sh/docs/mcp-playwright): Browser automation with backing Chromium
- [OpenTofu](https://devcell.sh/docs/mcp-opentofu): Infrastructure as code
- [KiCad](https://devcell.sh/docs/mcp-kicad): PCB design and schematic capture
- [Inkscape](https://devcell.sh/docs/mcp-inkscape): Vector graphics editing
- [Linear](https://devcell.sh/docs/mcp-linear): Issue tracking integration
